abilities.name: Overcoat
abilities.effect: Protects against damage from weather.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.

abilities.name: Slow Start
abilities.effect: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.
abilities.flavor_text: For five turns, the Pokémon's Attack and Speed stats are halved.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

abilities.name: Sharpness
abilities.effect: Powers up slicing moves.
abilities.flavor_text: Powers up slicing moves.

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.effect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.flavor_text: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.effect: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's Speed stat is boosted every turn.

abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.effect: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
abilities.flavor_text: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

abilities.name: Tinted Lens
abilities.effect: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.

abilities.name: Wonder Skin
abilities.effect: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.
abilities.flavor_text: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.

abilities.name: Justified
abilities.effect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.
abilities.flavor_text: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.effect: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
abilities.flavor_text: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.effect: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.3×.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

abilities.name: Friend Guard
abilities.effect: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.
abilities.flavor_text: Reduces damage dealt to allies.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.effect: Doubles the wild encounter rate.
abilities.flavor_text: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.effect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.flavor_text: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.effect: Raises non-damaging moves' priority by one stage.
abilities.flavor_text: Gives priority to the Pokémon's status moves.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.effect: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.flavor_text: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.effect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.flavor_text: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

abilities.name: Soundproof
abilities.effect: Protects against sound-based moves.
abilities.flavor_text: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

abilities.name: Static
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

abilities.name: Aftermath
abilities.effect: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.
abilities.flavor_text: Damages the attacker if it knocks out the Pokémon with a move that makes direct contact.

abilities.flavor_text: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

abilities.name: Drought
abilities.effect: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.flavor_text: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.
